item.title: WHYY Newscast for Tuesday, 2:00 p.m.
item.description: The latest local headlines from WHYY

item.title: El gobernador de Delaware, Matt Meyer, presenta su presupuesto para el año fiscal 2027, basado en recortes de gastos y aumentos de impuestos y tarifas
item.description: El presupuesto propuesto por Meyer “modernizaría” las tarifas de constitución de empresas y aumentaría los impuestos al tabaco para incrementar los ingresos estatales.

item.title: WHYY Newscast for Tuesday, 4:00 p.m.
item.description: The latest local headlines from WHYY

item.title: New bill helps cover costs associated with fraudulent home theft in Philadelphia
item.description: The bill refunds the realty transfer tax to the rightful homeowner instead of the thief who has been convicted of stealing the property.

item.title: ‘Brutal’ and ‘cruel’ ICE raid in Lower Providence sparks outrage from Montco elected officials
item.description: A Lower Providence Township supervisor at the scene of the raid Monday said she saw “children crying, a family in shock and a home destroyed after agents broke down the door.”

item.title: WHYY Newscast for Tuesday 5:00 p.m.
item.description: The latest local headlines from WHYY

item.title: At Pennsylvania 3rd Congressional District forum, primary candidates share policy goals but split on approach to power
item.description: Democratic candidates agreed on restoring health care subsidies and abolishing ICE but differed on who was most qualified to take Philly’s interests to Congress.

item.description: The latest local headlines from WHYY

item.title: Trump EPA set to repeal scientific finding that serves as basis for U.S. climate change policy
item.description: The Obama-era policy determined that carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases endanger public health and welfare. Legal challenges are certain.

item.title: Grand jury refuses to indict Democratic lawmakers in connection with illegal military orders video
item.description: Rep. Chrissy Houlahan and other Democrats had said the Trump administration was investigating them over the video.
